title: TEST RECORD (Sandbox): AI Governance Census of US Colleges and Universities
description:
Sandbox test of the release record. Not the dataset of record.

Browse the data, read the user guide, and download the files at kkcole-gif.github.io/ai-governance-census.

A stratified census of the documents through which US colleges and universities govern artificial intelligence, drawn from the 2025 Carnegie Classifications (334 institutions, seed 20261023). Each document is recorded with its issuing office, document type, standalone or embedded status, dates, a quoted passage, and verification status.
